name: moores-nim
description: Moore's Nim_k (lower up to k piles per move) and Exact k-Nim (lower exactly k piles) in the browser, with exact solvers, the Jenkyns–Mayberry formula, the Tetris function, and the checkable claims of Boros–Gurvich–Ho–Makino–Mursič (2017) and Boros–Gurvich–Kitrossky–Makino (2019) recomputed by exhaustive search. TypeScript, no runtime deps.
